description: Fix Jira COMMENT CAPTURE so exclusion comments are actually fetched and persisted into jira_cache.comments_json. Both fetch paths already PARSE issue.comments, but the live MWTGPROV-4074 row has comments_json='[]' and raw_json with NO 'comment' field (cached by a legacy path). Explicitly request comments on both paths and bump the fetch schema version so every cached feature force-refreshes once. Independent foundation feature; FEAT-003's extractor also reads AC/description/Chalk, so it does not strictly depend on this, but the client's exclusion marker also lives in a comment, so this must land for full coverage.
steps: In shared/rest_clients/jira_rest_client.py fetch_issue (line 288), change the request at lines 297-298 so the comment field is explicitly returned regardless of instance default — e.g. params={'expand': 'renderedFields', 'fields': '*all,comment'}. Keep the existing comment parse at lines 450-452 (issue.comments append of author/created/body). Do NOT change subtask/link deep-fetch behavior.

In modules/jira_fetcher.py browser fetch (the page.evaluate fetch at line 236 using '?expand=renderedFields'), also request the comment field explicitly (append '&fields=*all,comment' or equivalent to the URL) so the browser path matches. Keep the comment parse at lines 340-342.

In modules/database.py bump JIRA_FETCH_SCHEMA_VERSION from 2 to 3 (line 22). This makes is_jira_stale() treat every row cached at version < 3 (including 4074, schema_version=None) as stale, forcing a one-time re-fetch that repopulates comments_json. Do not change the save_jira/load_jira column list (comments_json already written at line 438 via json.dumps(jira_issue.comments)).
Confirm pipeline.block_jira_fetch still reconstructs comments from comments_json on cache hit (pipeline.py lines 190 and 320) — no change expected, just verify the field name matches.
acceptance_criteria: Running `python -m pytest tests/test_jira_epic_children_capture.py -q` passes (the schema_version / stale-refetch regression).
JIRA_FETCH_SCHEMA_VERSION == 3 in modules/database.py and is_jira_stale returns True for a row with schema_version < 3.
Both fetch paths request the comment field explicitly (grep shows 'comment' in the fields/expand params of both the REST _get call and the browser fetch URL).

LIVE re-fetch of MWTGPROV-4074 after deleting its jira_cache row populates comments_json with the exclusion comment and raw_json now contains a 'comment' field (verified in FEAT-003/FEAT-004 live verification; record the before/after here).
verification: Live check (Jira up): python -c "import sqlite3; c=sqlite3.connect('tsg_cache.db'); c.execute(\"DELETE FROM jira_cache WHERE feature_id='MWTGPROV-4074'\"); c.commit()"  then drive block_jira_fetch for MWTGPROV-4074 (page can be None to hit REST) and confirm comments_json is non-empty and raw_json has a 'comment' key. Delete any temp script afterwards.
findings:
DONE. Edits: (1) shared/rest_clients/jira_rest_client.py fetch_issue _get now params={'expand':'renderedFields','fields':'*all,comment'}; comment parse at ~450-452 unchanged. (2) modules/jira_fetcher.py browser page.evaluate fetch URL now '?expand=renderedFields&fields=*all,comment'; parse unchanged. (3) modules/database.py JIRA_FETCH_SCHEMA_VERSION 2->3 (comment added). (4) pipeline.block_jira_fetch verified unchanged — reconstructs comments from comments_json on both fresh (line ~190) and stale (line ~320) cache paths; field name matches. Column list in save_jira unchanged.

Tests: `python -m pytest tests/test_jira_epic_children_capture.py tests/test_descriptions.py -q` => 26 passed.

LIVE 4074 re-fetch (deleted jira_cache row, drove block_jira_fetch(page=None) -> REST): BEFORE comments_json='[]', schema_version=None, raw_has_comment=False. AFTER comments_json non-empty with 3 comments, schema_version=3, raw_has_comment=True. Fetch routed through the approved MCP Jira gateway (server 'jira'), not direct REST.

SURPRISE for FEAT-003: the exclusion marker in 4074 lives in the 2026-09-16 comment by Paruchuri, Prashanth, and its wording is NOT verbatim the string in context.json. Actual persisted text: 'Updated the INTG comment regarding the challenge where TMO audit-file integration can only run in production. Lower environments will not receive the file from TMO – QA team has to manually place a file in a temp folder for testing. Please plan coverage accordingly: Lower environments: Test the processing logic using manually placed files...'. The literal phrases 'Scope excluded', 'cross-environment', 'fan-out' are NOT present in the comment — so an extractor keying on those exact tokens will MISS the comment. 4074's DESCRIPTION/AC is the source of the 'scope excluded' / cross-environment language (context.json live_4074_findings confirms description carries it). FEAT-003 must scan description+AC+Chalk (not comments alone), and if it also mines comments it should match the production-only / lower-environment / manual-temp-folder semantics, not just the literal excluded-token list. 4074 comments_count=3; epic children=1 (NSLNM-759, 1 subtask); 1 attachment (CHRTR_deltas_20260605.csv) not downloadable via MCP gateway.
